title: Mike Vecchione: Live from the Stress Factory
overview: Get ready for razor-sharp stand-up from one of the best joke writers in comedy. In his brand-new special, comedian Mike Vecchione delivers nonstop laughs in front of a packed house at the legendary Stress Factory in New Jersey. Mike tackles everything we’re all navigating in America right now: Cracker Barrel and Waffle House culture, the confusing nightmare of health insurance at 50, how to watch American politics, and being married to someone from the Midwest
